title: Session draft-PR action and publication identity setting
forbidden_scope: repoask/web/app.js unless a one-line registration is unavoidable (record it)
acceptance: Terminal session page offers Create draft PR: preview (POST publication-preview) shows repository, base -> head branch, diff stats, changed paths, checks (failed/unavailable disclosed), editable title/body, and blocking reasons with a fix link (e.g. identity -> Settings)
Publish sends exactly title, body, expected_diff_hash (from preview), intent_version, and a client idempotency key that is reused on double click and on network-error resubmit

After publish the panel follows GET /api/publications/{id}: queued/preparing/creating_*/reconciling show progress; published shows draft PR link (only the exact https://github.com URL from the API, opened rel=noopener); blocked/failed show the code in plain language; no_changes explained; reconciling offers Retry (POST retry with a fresh key) only when the API allows
Settings exposes commit name and email (GET/PATCH /api/settings/publication) with validation errors shown
Never renders tokens or raw GitHub bodies; no merge action exists; keyboard and screen-reader accessible; matches the redesigned dark UI
Focused UI tests plus full node --test tests/ui/*.test.mjs pass
